## PART A — DILIGENCE INDEX (House-Rule Format)

> Every entry: `DOC-IDX-<n> | <fact> | <risk level>`
> Risk levels: **CRITICAL** · **HIGH** · **MEDIUM** · **LOW** · **INFO**

### A.1 — Assignment & Consent Requirements

| Entry | Fact | Risk Level |
|---|---|---|
| DOC-IDX-001 | Material contracts (≥3) contain anti-assignment clauses requiring counterparty consent prior to closing; consents not yet obtained as of index date. | **CRITICAL** |
| DOC-IDX-002 | Government/regulatory licenses identified that are non-transferable by operation of law; re-issuance in acquiror's name required post-close. | **CRITICAL** |
| DOC-IDX-003 | Key customer agreement (top-3 by revenue) requires 30-day prior written notice of change of control; notice period may not clear before scheduled closing. | **HIGH** |
| DOC-IDX-004 | Lease agreements (primary operating premises) contain landlord consent-to-assignment provisions; estoppel certificates not yet executed. | **HIGH** |
| DOC-IDX-005 | Software license agreements (enterprise SaaS) include assignment-by-operation-of-law carve-outs; structure of transaction (stock vs. asset) must be confirmed to assess whether consent is triggered. | **HIGH** |
| DOC-IDX-006 | Employment agreements with change-of-control provisions identified for 4 senior officers; golden-parachute and §280G analysis required. | **HIGH** |
| DOC-IDX-007 | IP assignment agreements from founders to target entity: 2 of 5 founders have not executed confirmatory assignments for pre-incorporation IP. | **CRITICAL** |
| DOC-IDX-008 | Third-party consent tracker initiated; 7 of 14 required consents received; 7 outstanding as of index date. | **HIGH** |

### A.4 — Change-of-Control Provisions

| Entry | Fact | Risk Level |
|---|---|---|
| DOC-IDX-017 | Change-of-control definition in indenture (subordinated notes, $15M outstanding) triggers put right at 101% of par; estimated cash outlay at closing: $15.15M. | **CRITICAL** |
| DOC-IDX-018 | Debt facility (revolving credit, $10M commitment) contains change-of-control event of default; lender consent or payoff letter required before closing. | **CRITICAL** |
| DOC-IDX-019 | Equity incentive plan: 100% acceleration of unvested options upon change of control (double-trigger for some, single-trigger for others); intrinsic value of accelerating awards estimated at $2.1M — §409A and §280G exposure to be confirmed. | **HIGH** |
| DOC-IDX-020 | Government contract (15% of LTM revenue) contains novation requirement under FAR 42.12 upon change of control; novation process averages 90–180 days; revenue continuity risk during gap period. | **HIGH** |
| DOC-IDX-021 | Two SaaS platform agreements (critical infrastructure) include change-of-control termination right exercisable by vendor within 30 days of closing; business continuity risk if exercised. | **HIGH** |
| DOC-IDX-022 | Real property leases (3 locations) contain change-of-control termination rights; landlord estoppel and consent waivers required. | **MEDIUM** |
| DOC-IDX-023 | Insurance policies (D&O, E&O, cyber) do not automatically extend to acquiror post-close; run-off / tail coverage (6-year) must be bound at or before closing. | **MEDIUM** |

| Gross Purchase Price | $[●] | Acquiror → Paying Agent | Per Purchase Agreement |
| Less: Estimated Closing Indebtedness | ($[●]) | Acquiror → Lenders (per payoff letters) | Includes CST-003, CST-004 |

### D.2 — Payment Waterfall

1. **Debt Payoffs** — Wire directly to lenders per payoff letters (CST-003, CST-004); obtain and record lien releases simultaneously.
2. **Transaction Expenses** — Wire to deal counsel, financial advisors, and other service providers per invoices delivered at closing.
3. **Escrow Funding** — Wire to escrow agent per executed escrow agreement.
4. **Option Holder Payments** — Net exercise proceeds distributed through payroll (withholding applies); §280G gross-up (if any) paid per employment agreement.
5. **Stockholder Consideration** — Distributed by paying agent to stockholders of record per pro-rata allocation / waterfall (preferred liquidation preferences, if any, applied first).
6. **Seller Representative Expense Fund** — Funded from consideration per Purchase Agreement.

### D.3 — Wire Instruction Confirmation Protocol

- [ ] Wire instructions for each payee confirmed in writing by payee (not via email from deal parties alone — verbal or secure portal confirmation required).
- [ ] Final wire amounts confirmed with acquiror's treasury 48 hours before closing.
- [ ] CFO and deal counsel to counter-confirm all wire instructions on closing morning.
- [ ] Escrow agent to confirm receipt and release upon satisfaction of closing conditions.

## PART E — BRING-DOWN OF REPRESENTATIONS & WARRANTIES

### E.1 — Bring-Down Standard

Per the Purchase Agreement, representations and warranties of the Target must be true and correct as of the Closing Date **as if made on the Closing Date** (subject to any materiality or Material Adverse Effect qualifiers set forth in the Agreement). Fundamental Representations must be **true and correct in all respects**; all other representations must be true and correct **in all material respects** (or without giving effect to any materiality qualifier, other than as would not constitute or be reasonably expected to constitute a Material Adverse Effect).
